text_block_list.text:
The showdown concluded... and Mejiro Ryan 
let out a roar filled with a surge of
deep 
emotion, echoing across the venue.

Having lost the contest, Mejiro McQueen 
praises her victory and declares this 
battle to be the dawn of a golden age for 
the Mejiro family.

Having achieved great results,
the curtain 
came down on the Kikuka Sho.

Her next battle is the Arima Kinen.
Mejiro 
Ryan begins taking action toward a race 
where unknown powerhouses await.
